text:
- A circular lifecycle diagram with five icons and labels:
  - "DESIGN AND SOURCE" at the top with a recycling symbol icon
  - "MAKE" on the right with a solar panel icon
  - "PACKAGE AND SHIP" at the bottom right with a globe icon
  - "USE" at the bottom left with a plant and plug icon
  - "RECOVER" on the left with a flexed arm and leaf icon

- Three illustrated sections at the bottom, each with a header, text, and an illustration:
  - Header: "Smarter chemicals" with an illustration of four bottles and containers (including a spray bottle and a waste bin with a recycling symbol).
  - Header: "Zero Waste to Landfill" with an illustration of a solar panel array.
  - Header: "Supplier energy use" with an illustration of three wind turbines.
